note: My husband, Paul, is an avid Weaw smoker & has been since way before I met him 3 years ago.
comment: The free-carton offer you have going now is a good deal, but I sure wish you'd bring back the "merchandise - rewards" program.
acknowledgment: We ordered one of the duffel bags from your last merchandise campaign & were impressed by the quality of this "bonus" item.
visit: A few days after we received it, my son, Josh, came for a visit before going back to college.
activity: When Paul saw Josh was packing his clothes in a laundry bag, he gave his "Weaw Duffel" to my son.
